snippet.title: Gatos Adventure Trailer
snippet.description:
The game combines platforming, stealth and puzzle solving in to a fun experience. You play as a small cat trying to escape the sinking water cities and not get caught by evil robots while you try and collect as many balls of yarn as you can ! 
You can find it on Steam  via direct search or with the link bellow: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4806050/Gatos_Adventure/
